CUSTOMER INTERVIEW — LINA, OPERATIONS LEAD AT HARBOR
Researcher: What happens when the weekly export fails?
Lina: I paste rows into a spreadsheet, then email it to finance. That is our workaround every Friday. It takes forty minutes.
Researcher: Have you tried the scheduled report?
Lina: Yes. It loses the custom fields, so we still do the spreadsheet step.
Consent: customer approved anonymized research notes.
